_comment: Listings a human or Claude has read in full and cleared, with the reason. The detector is high-recall and will keep flagging these on every run, so record the screening decision here rather than loosening the regexes and losing real hits elsewhere. Keyed by file path.
content/destinations/clinics/amy-jean-ey: First-person hit is inside Amy Jean's own quote about being an artist. A practitioner describing her philosophy is not a testimonial about a good or service, and brow and lash work is not a regulated health service. Laser and LED appear on the menu only.
content/destinations/clinics/vaia-beauty: First-person hits are inside Vaia Pappas's own quotes about her approach and about the Ultraceuticals range. She is not a registered health practitioner, Ultraceuticals is a cosmetic rather than a therapeutic good, and neither quote claims an outcome. LED appears on the menu only.
content/destinations/clinics/the-victori: Claim hit is 'prevention rather than cure' inside Derya Koch's quote describing her general approach. It is a statement of clinical philosophy, not a claim that any named treatment prevents or cures a disease, and no product or service is attached to it.
